inspections.title: Not enough food or fluids
inspections.detail: Provide enough food/fluids to maintain a resident's health.

inspections.title: Facility not run effectively
inspections.detail: Administer the facility in a manner that enables it to use its resources effectively and efficiently.

inspections.title: Quality improvement plan missing
inspections.detail: Have a  plan that describes the process for conducting QAPI and QAA activities.

inspections.title: Conduct and document a facility-wide assessment to determine what resources are necessary to care for residents competently during both day-to-day operations (including nights and weekends) and emergencies
inspections.detail: Conduct and document a facility-wide assessment to determine what resources are necessary to care for residents competently during both day-to-day operations (including nights and weekends) and emergencies.

inspections.title: Have an agreement with at least one or more hospitals certified by Medicare or Medicaid to make sure residents can be moved quickly to the hospital when they need medical care
inspections.detail: Have an agreement with at least one or more hospitals certified by Medicare or Medicaid to make sure residents can be moved quickly to the hospital when they need medical care.

inspections.title: Ensure that the resident and his/her doctor meet face-to-face at all required visits
inspections.detail: Ensure that the resident and his/her doctor meet face-to-face at all required visits.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Resident dignity not respected
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.

inspections.title: Unnecessary psychiatric drugs (sedating medications)
inspections.detail: Prevent the use of unnecessary psychotropic medications or use medications that may restrain a resident's ability to function.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Resident assessment inaccurate
inspections.detail: Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.

inspections.title: Help with daily activities not provided
inspections.detail: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Pressure sores not prevented or treated
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.

inspections.title: Mobility / range-of-motion care not provided
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate care for a resident to maintain and/or improve range of motion (ROM), limited ROM and/or mobility, unless a decline is for a medical reason.

inspections.title: Breathing / oxygen care problems
inspections.detail: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.

inspections.title: Pharmacist drug review not done properly
inspections.detail: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.

inspections.title: Medications not labeled or stored correctly
inspections.detail: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.

inspections.title: Medications not labeled or stored correctly
inspections.detail: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: Unclean or uncomfortable living space
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

inspections.title: Discharge notice not given
inspections.detail: Provide timely notification to the resident, and if applicable to the resident representative and ombudsman, before transfer or discharge, including appeal rights.

inspections.title: Unnecessary medications given
inspections.detail: Ensure each resident’s drug regimen must be free from unnecessary drugs.

inspections.title: Significant medication error
inspections.detail: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.
